turnaround_reason: Once a 30%+ grower, Inspire's hypoglossal-nerve-stimulation OSA implant franchise decelerated to ~2% revenue growth and the stock fell ~66% from its $147 high on fears that FDA-approved GLP-1s (tirzepatide) will shrink the OSA implant market. Thesis is that the GLP-1 fear is overdone (implant serves CPAP-intolerant moderate/severe patients that weight-loss drugs don't fully address) and that a high-margin, net-cash, FCF-positive franchise trading at ~11x trailing earnings is oversold.
bullish_points: Dominant share in hypoglossal nerve stimulation; competition (Nyxoah, LivaNova) still viewed as undifferentiated
High quality financials: 86% gross margins, ~$85M FCF, net cash (~$284M cash vs ~$30M debt), 6.3x current ratio
Cheap on trailing metrics (~11x trailing PE, 1.3x EV/revenue) after a 66% drawdown
Strong recent earnings-beat cadence (Q1 +0.10 vs -0.26 est; prior quarters beat by 100%+)
Net insider buying over last 6m (net ~211k shares) and price stabilizing above 100d MA (~99% of 100d)
bearish_points: Structural GLP-1 overhang: tirzepatide is FDA-approved for OSA and cuts AHI meaningfully, capping the addressable implant market
Growth has collapsed to ~2%; FY26 guide implies only 4-10% growth with a projected net loss and higher capex
Forward PE ~39 vs trailing ~11 signals the market expects near-term earnings to fall
Analyst mean target $52 is barely above the current $49.5 with a 'hold' consensus — limited institutional upside expectation
Options are effectively illiquid (double/triple-digit OI), so no leveraged expression available
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings — investors want evidence that growth is stabilizing and that GLP-1 adoption is not cannibalizing the implant funnel
suggested_trade: Small spot position only (no options); scale entry $46-50, add on confirmation post-earnings if growth stabilizes
key_risk: GLP-1s prove to be a genuine structural share-taker in OSA, permanently resetting Inspire's growth and multiple lower
would_skip_if: Q2 print shows further deceleration or explicit GLP-1-driven procedure softness; or you require a liquid options market to size the position
